name: 54235 · Sturgeon Bay, WI
findings: ZIP 54235 (Sturgeon Bay) has 104 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 54235 (Sturgeon Bay) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 54235 (Sturgeon Bay) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
